settings.token.label: lazyagent bearer token
settings.token.description: Leave empty to derive it automatically from `lazyagent passphrase --show`. Set it manually if the lazyagent binary is not on PATH.
settings.lazyagent_bin.label: lazyagent binary
settings.lazyagent_bin.description: Name or full path of the lazyagent executable, as seen from the Noctalia process (its PATH may differ from your shell).
widget.bin_not_found: Binary not found: {bin}. Set `lazyagent_bin` to a full path (e.g. /home/inner/go/bin/lazyagent).
settings.language.label: Language
settings.language.description: Display language for the widget. 'Auto' follows the shell language.
